rule:
Per-clip retakes for a CONCRETE raw-QA defect only (a clipped onset: the
word already sounding at the file's first sample). Same exact voice ID,
model, voice settings, output format and canonical script; only the seed
moves on (31, 32, ...), because seed 30 is reproducible and would return the
same defective take. Retakes go to raw_retakes/seed<N>/<stable_id>/; the
seed-30 originals stay untouched in raw/ as evidence. Never used to change a
voice's character or to rescue a voice.
Usage: python -I generate_retakes.py <repo> <seed> <stable_id:clip> [...]

clips.script: One active job. One job that keeps you on your feet — sweeping, hoovering, carrying things — at a pace that feels comfortable.
One task, no switching. Pick one task on your mind and put everything else out of sight. Stay with it until the time’s up — finished or not.
Screen-free walk. Silence your notifications and keep your phone in your pocket. Walk easily, and look around you rather than at a screen.
Stand and reach. Stand up and reach both arms overhead, only as high as is comfortable, then lower them slowly. Three or four times.
One task, no switching. Pick one task on your mind and put everything else out of sight. Stay with it until the time’s up — finished or not.
Sit outside. Find somewhere outside to sit, with your phone in your pocket. Listen to what you can hear, near and far.
